data.description: A Reed Warden is a Medium Humanoid that guards raised paths through the marsh. Armor Class 12; Hit Points 9; Speed 30 feet. Strength 10, Dexterity 14, Constitution 10, Intelligence 10, Wisdom 12, Charisma 10. Staff: Melee Attack Roll +2, reach 5 feet, one target; Hit: 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage. Once per Long Rest, the warden can use an action to light a safe path for 2 minutes. It cannot use this signal while submerged. It carries one Signal Lantern.

data.description: A Signal Lantern is a wondrous item with 3 charges. While holding it, you can take an action and expend 1 charge to send a Marshlight signal for 1 minute. The lantern regains all expended charges at dawn. A shutter changes the signal color without expending a charge. A broken lantern cannot send signals. Amber requests a meeting; blue marks a safe route.

data.description: Marshlight is a level 1 Illusion spell. Casting Time: Action. Range: 30 feet. Components: V, S. Duration: 1 minute. Choose one visible post within range. It shines blue, marking a safe route for the duration. The light ends early if the post is submerged. It deals no damage.
